entries.text: QuestDB writes an unpadded date literal in zero-padded form, and DataFusion pads an unpadded TIMESTAMP cast. QuestDB read CAST('1999-5-01' AS DATE) as NULL and rejected a bare '1999-5-01' compared with a date, so the dsqgen date [YEAR]-[MONTH]-01 in TPC-DS Q16, Q94 and Q95 (base and tpcds_obt) produced NULL or invalid bounds; DataFusion raised an error for CAST('1999-5-1 3:04:05' AS TIMESTAMP). ClickHouse, Spark, Trino, PostgreSQL, DuckDB, StarRocks and Doris read the unpadded text correctly and are unchanged.

Translation keeps the NULL placement of the source dialect where the target has no NULLS FIRST or NULLS LAST clause for the position. Positional ORDER BY keys, windows under a frame and non-DISTINCT BigQuery ARRAY_AGG ordering now sort on a leading IS NULL key instead of dropping the clause with a warning, and the QuestDB dialect sorts NULLs smallest without a NULLS clause. TPC-DS Q74 on T-SQL, Doris and StarRocks is the one query whose sort keys contain NULLs in the data checked.

Spark and Databricks write a REGEXP_REPLACE replacement group reference as $N instead of the backslash form, and write sub-day DATE_TRUNC units (minute, hour, second, millisecond, microsecond) as DATE_TRUNC because TRUNC returns NULL for them. ClickBench Q29 and Q43 on Databricks and Spark measured different work before this change.
